_note: Map your WMS export to the fields Slotwise needs. Copy this file to schema.json and edit the right-hand values to match your own column names, file names and flag values. Nothing here is tied to a particular WMS.

flags._note: Values as they appear in your export. warehouse_id filters rows to one site; status_done marks a completed movement; location_locked is the status id of a cell that must never be suggested.

location_format._note: Location codes are parsed as PREFIX + AISLE - SEQUENCE - FLOOR, e.g. R14-07-06.

file_signatures._note: Optional. Header names (lowercased, non-alphanumerics stripped) that identify each file when several CSVs are uploaded at once. Leave empty to fall back on shape-based detection.

category_names._note: Optional. Map your category id to a display name, e.g. "1001": "Dry goods". Ids not listed here are shown as-is.
